04 / DATA & TRUST

Nothing behind
a black box.

Where the data comes from

A restricted server reads official Solana mainnet or devnet RPC. We request getTransaction with finalized commitment and check the network genesis hash. Explorer links help you inspect the transaction; they do not supply the verdict.

Solana transaction documentation

What stays with you

CSV files and expectations are processed in your browser. Our server and the RPC receive queried signatures and connection metadata; public transaction results may be cached in memory for 60 seconds. Reports leave the page when you download them. No separate application account, analytics or wallet connection is required.

What a match means

The supported transfer agrees with your expected recipient, mint and amount. It does not prove a debtor’s identity, a bounty’s legitimacy, token value or invoice association. Reuse detection covers the current batch only.

Where we stop

Simple legacy SPL Token transfers are supported. Token-2022, swaps and custom programs require manual review. Public RPC is rate-limited without a service guarantee. A provider response is not a cryptographic attestation.

RPC availability and limits
